references.text: The same command to fear the Lord, serve him, and swear by his name is repeated here in Deuteronomy.
Jesus quotes this verse when he is tempted by Satan, confirming that only the Lord should be worshiped and served.
Luke's account of Jesus' temptation, where he quotes this verse to reject Satan's offer of power.
The prohibition against misusing the Lord's name in the Ten Commandments relates to the command to swear by his name.
The repetition of the command not to misuse the Lord's name, which connects to swearing by his name.
Those who swear by God's name shall consider themselves blessed, showing the proper use of swearing by his name.
The prophecy that every knee will bow and every tongue will swear by God's name.
The command to swear 'As surely as the Lord lives' in truth, justice, and righteousness.
